evidence.title: Architecture

evidence.title: Queue state
evidence.finding: Persistent YAML queue with claim states and a file lock so one runner claims each task.

evidence.title: Workflow handler

evidence.title: Event recorder
evidence.finding: Records every run as NDJSON events plus a summary under .ccswarm/runs.

evidence.title: Human approval gate

evidence.title: Built-in hooks

evidence.title: Resource monitor

evidence.title: Isolation modes

evidence.title: Session bridge
